finding.claim: UrlencodedBodyDecoder silently drops form fields not declared in the schema, so additionalProperties:false is never enforced for application/x-www-form-urlencoded bodies.
finding.source: HTTP request body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) from any client; validate_request.go:329 selects UrlencodedBodyDecoder
finding.sink: Validation of decoded object at validate_request.go:364 (VisitJSON) never sees undeclared keys

trace.note: only declared props assigned to obj; undeclared url.Values keys discarded
schema VisitJSON on obj cannot reject extra keys

finding.guards_checked: No unknown-key check in UrlencodedBodyDecoder. Multipart equivalent at req_resp_decoder.go:1569-1584 does reject undeclared parts. No urlencoded additionalProperties test in req_resp_decoder_test.go (only multipart at 1800-1823).

finding.claim: deepSet performs an unchecked type assertion m[key].(map[string]any); with conflicting deepObject query keys (e.g. obj[a]=1&obj[a][b]=2) and random map iteration order in makeObject, it panics about half the time.
finding.source: Query string keys on a deepObject-styled object parameter, e.g. ?obj[a]=1&obj[a][b]=2 (unauthenticated)
finding.sink: deepSet type assertion at req_resp_decoder.go:929, reached via makeObject

trace.note: range over map props: random order
m['a'] is string when 'a' is set first -> assertion panics

finding.guards_checked: No ok-check on the assertion; no recover in the library. net/http recovers per request, so the impact is a per-request panic and dropped connection rather than a process crash.

finding.claim: Authentication failures in ValidationHandler are returned as HTTP 500 and the AuthenticationFunc error text is written verbatim to the client.
finding.source: Any unauthenticated request to a route with security requirements; AuthenticationFunc error (user code) propagated at validate_request.go:497-502
finding.sink: ErrorEncoder (DefaultErrorEncoder) writes err.Error() to the response body

trace.note: ConvertErrors has no branch for security errors; returns raw err

finding.guards_checked: ConvertErrors and DefaultErrorEncoder do not map security errors to 401/403 or redact messages. The Middleware path (middleware.go:136) uses code.responseText() and is not affected.

finding.claim: Default logger writes the full request URL (including query string) for unmatched routes, and validation error text containing raw parameter values, so tokens sent in query or parameters land in logs.
finding.source: Attacker- or user-supplied query string and parameter values (e.g. ?token=... or a non-integer value in an integer param)
finding.sink: log.Printf via default logFunc (middleware.go:68-69), called at middleware.go:124 and :135
finding.guards_checked: No redaction. Default logger applies unless OnLog is set (middleware.go:95-99). Conflicts with the org policy against logging tokens at any level.

finding.claim: RejectWhenRequestBodyNotSpecified checks ContentLength > 0, which is -1 for chunked requests, so a body sent with Transfer-Encoding: chunked to an operation with no declared body is accepted.
finding.source: Chunked HTTP request body to an operation without requestBody

trace.note: security path returns early with no requirements, so ContentLength is not corrected at :517-519

finding.guards_checked: Option is opt-in (options.go:31-32). When a security requirement applies, body restore (validate_request.go:517-519) resets ContentLength, which closes the gap only in that case.

finding.claim: ZipFileBodyDecoder appends the full 256-byte read buffer instead of buffer[:n], so validated content includes stale or zero bytes and differs from the actual decompressed data; there is also no output size cap.
finding.source: Zip body uploaded by client, only when the application registers ZipFileBodyDecoder
finding.sink: Decoded string handed to schema validation (validate_request.go:364)
finding.guards_checked: No size limit (documented as zip-bomb-prone at req_resp_decoder.go:1658). Not registered in init() (req_resp_decoder.go:1377-1392), so opt-in only.
